action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage of all legal White moves to establish the strongest candidates.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search, so candidate_moves must be empty. No prior analyses exist, so a full root sweep at target depth 4 is required before selecting any candidate. Black's last move g7g5 signals a kingside pawn advance; I need to see which White moves score best and whether any tactical motifs (Qxd7+?, Qxc5, Rxb4) or king-safety issues (Qxc2+) exist. Using 3000 of 6000 nodes, reserving the rest for verification.
